description: The Asian Transport Observatory’s national database provides about 400 transport and policy indicators for 51 Asia-Pacific economies. This Zenodo archive preserves successive workbook versions for reproducible research, including files dated from 2022 to July 2026. The provider organises indicators into nine themes and supplies definitions and source links. Excel workbooks are freely downloadable. No standard open licence is stated; the provider permits attributed personal and non-profit use and requires written permission for commercial use. These indicators can supply national demand, infrastructure and policy assumptions for transport simulations. They combine primary and secondary sources with varying years and completeness, so uncertainty and comparability need checking indicator by indicator. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this archive. Workbooks were not downloaded, and the mirror’s completeness against the current website was not audited.
